claims.value: MRC-5 parental, GFP-Trap pull-down, basal (rows 1-16) / MRC-5 MPLKIP-GFP knock-in, GFP-Trap pull-down, basal (rows 17-32)
claims.evidence: Paper Results: 'differential SILAC of MRC-5 MPLKIP-GFP knock-in cells and the MRC-5 parental control cell line ... performed on GFP-pull-down samples from whole cell extracts of both cell lines'; PRIDE protocol: GFP-Trap A beads. 'basal' = MaxQuant experiment 'Basal Complex' of these 16 files.

Methods/PRIDE: unlabelled Arg/Lys 'control, light'; 13C6,15N4 Arg + 13C6,15N2 Lys 'MPLKIP-GFP, heavy'. Fig 3A legend: CTR light, MPLKIP-GFP heavy, ratio H/L = MPLKIP-GFP/CTR. summary.txt: Multiplicity 2, Labels1 Arg10;Lys8 on all 16 files (rule 14). Deposited-ratio check (rule 6), 1802_proteinGroups.txt 'Ratio H/L normalized Basal Complex': bait MPLKIP 21.4, paper's top interactors DBR1 22.7, CWF19L1 27.8, AQR 25.5, ISY1 23.7, XAB2 21.6, PLK1 10.7 vs ACTB 0.95, GAPDH 0.47 -> heavy carries the GFP bait.
Fig EV2/Results: MRC-5 MPLKIP-TEV(2x)-FLAG-GFP knock-in cells vs MRC-5 parental (CTR); the compared variable of the SILAC IP is the presence of the GFP-tagged bait.
These 16 files form MaxQuant experiment 'Basal Complex'; the paper's SILAC experiment describes no treatment. Template-prescribed control value (rule 4).
GFP-Trap A immunoprecipitation of whole cell extracts before SDS-PAGE (PRIDE protocol/Methods); EFO:0009106 is the closest child of EFO:0009090 (no affinity-purification child exists).
Paper: 'SV40-immortalized MRC-5' (Methods cell culture), 'MRC-5 cells (CTR)' (Fig 3A). EFO:0002835 label 'MRC5' (synonym MRC-5).
PRIDE organism NEWT:9606; Cellosaurus CVCL_0440 OX NCBI_TaxID=9606.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0440 'Derived from site: In situ; Fetal lung' (shared by all SV40 derivatives via HI). UBERON:0002048.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0440 'Cell type: Fibroblast of lung; CL=CL_0002553'.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0440 and its SV40 derivatives: SX Male.
MRC-5 is a normal fetal lung fibroblast line (Cellosaurus: no DI disease line); PATO:0000461.
Cultured immortalized cell line.
Both channels are experimental pull-downs, not references.
Each channel is one cell population's pull-down; the two channels are mixed 1:1 in the run but are separate samples (Fig 3A legend).
One pull-down per genotype in experiment 'Basal Complex'; numbering restarts per factor group (rule 3).
SILAC culture 'in DMEM containing 10% dialysed FBS ... GlutaMAX ... penicillin-streptomycin'; NCIT:C185409.

claims.evidence: summary.txt assigns exactly these 16 files to experiment 'Basal Complex' (MaxQuant Fraction column absent). Lanes were cut into 2-mm slices (Methods) -> the 8 numbered files per series are the gel slices; number = slice order (assumed from file numbering). Raw headers: high_* acquired with method '60min_FTIT_3sec_flex_75um_CSH_int_high__2E5' (precursor intensity range 2E5-5E10), low_* with '..._int_low__5E3' (5E3-2E5): the same slice set injected twice with complementary precursor-intensity windows -> technical replicates 1 and 2.
Eluates 'separated on 4-12% Bis-Tris NuPAGE gels. Lanes were cut into 2-mm slices'. PRIDE:0000568 is under PRIDE:0000550 Fractionation method.

All 16 raw headers: 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos', LC 'Thermo EASY-nLC'. PRIDE instrument agrees. The paper's SILAC Methods text (Q Exactive + Agilent 1100) is contradicted by the raw files; raw headers win.
'a data-dependent mode was used'; raw method: dependent scans with dynamic exclusion 20 s, charge 2-5.
Raw headers: ActivationType = HCD (all 16).
Raw headers: Collision Energy (%) = 30 (all 16), stepped CE off.
Method name 'FTIT' and Detector Type = IonTrap for the MS2 scan (Orbitrap for MS1, 60K); the Lumos ion trap is a linear ion trap.
Raw headers: Scan Range (m/z) = 350-1400 (all 16).
In-gel digestion 'with trypsin (sequencing grade; Promega)'. MaxQuant search rule Trypsin/P (summary.txt) recorded here, not in the SDRF (rule 2).
'in-gel reduction with dithiothreitol'.
'alkylation with iodoacetamide (98%; D4, Cambridge Isotope Laboratories)' - see limitations for the D4 wording.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 16 of 60 deposited RAW files annotated (MaxQuant experiment 'Basal Complex'). 32 SILAC RAW files 1802_L_AlexPines_high_09..24 and 1802_L_AlexPines_low_09..24 (experiments 'UV Complex' and 'MMC Complex') are BLOCKED: the paper never describes UV- or MMC-treated SILAC pull-downs, and the deposited ratios show their channel map differs from the published one (bait MPLKIP H/L normalized 0.64 in UV, 0.97 in MMC, vs 21.4 in Basal), so the light/heavy identities are undocumented. See annotations/BLOCKED.md section PXD044779.

OUT OF SCOPE: 12 RAW files 2427_L_{15SEP22,20SEP22}_AlexPines_{1_Ctrl1..6_Clone7_3}.raw are label-free DIA (raw method '180min_FTOT_3sec_DIA_variable_window...'; Spectronaut report; paper Methods 'Label-free mass spectrometry analysis on MPLKIP-deficient epidermis') and are byte-identical (name+SHA-1+size) to the 12 RAW of PXD044434, which the paper's Data availability names as the accession for that nLC-MS/MS data. Not SILAC; not annotated in this SILAC campaign.

Technical replicate interpretation of high/low: inferred from the raw instrument methods (complementary precursor-intensity windows 2E5-5E10 vs 5E3-2E5) and identical 01..08 numbering within one MaxQuant experiment; no text states that the low_NN run is the same slice as high_NN.
Gel slice order = file number 01..08 (assumed; MaxQuant summary has no Fraction column).

Fixed modifications are not deposited (MaxQuant 1.5 summary.txt has no Fixed modifications column; no parameters.txt or mqpar.xml). The paper alkylated with iodoacetamide described as '(98%; D4, Cambridge Isotope Laboratories)', which may denote deuterated iodoacetamide-d4; whether the search used Carbamidomethyl (UNIMOD:4) or a deuterated variant is unknown, so no cysteine modification is written.
Search tolerances not documented -> 'not available'; parse_sdrf convert-openms therefore fails (expected, precedent PXD006676/PXD004817).
Instrument conflict: the paper's SILAC Methods (and PRIDE sample protocol) say 'Q-Exactive' with an Agilent 1100 LC; all 16 raw headers say Orbitrap Fusion Lumos with EASY-nLC. Raw headers used.
Label conflict: the Fig 3A legend says heavy = 'Arg10/Lys6'; Methods/PRIDE say 13C6,15N4-Arg + 13C6,15N2-Lys (= Arg10/Lys8) and the MaxQuant search used Arg10;Lys8. Arg10/Lys8 used.

Cell line: the paper says 'SV40-immortalized MRC-5' without naming the derivative; Cellosaurus has several SV40 transformants of MRC-5 (e.g. MRC-5V1 CVCL_D690, MRC-5V2 CVCL_2627, MRC-5 CV1 CVCL_E260). cell line written as the parent-strain name MRC5 (EFO:0002835); cellosaurus accession/name 'not available'.

Age: Cellosaurus AG 14FW (fetal week 14); not written (age pattern cannot express gestational age; developmental stage 'fetal stage' exists only in HsapDv, not in the EFO the template requires, so that optional column was omitted).
No review performed by the producer: REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL.
